parameters.content:
## 📧 Job Application Email Sequence
**Flow:** Schedule → ON/OFF gate (Settings!A2) → 10:00–18:00 IST window gate → read ALL raw tabs → normalize & merge with Tracker → per-contact loop: decide → reply-check → send / follow-up in the same Gmail thread → update Tracker → append Log.

**Outreach state lives in the `Tracker` tab** (raw tabs are read-only), so messy source tabs can never break tracking. To adapt later to a single merged sheet, just leave one data tab in the spreadsheet — nothing else changes.

## ⚙️ Setup (one time)
1. Set `spreadsheet_id` in **Workflow Config**.
2. Attach your **Google Sheets OAuth** credential to the 5 Sheets nodes **and** to `List All Sheet Tabs` (HTTP Request). Attach **Gmail OAuth** to the 3 Gmail nodes.
3. In the spreadsheet create 3 utility tabs (names must match Workflow Config):
   - `Settings` → A1: `master_switch`, A2: `ON` (or `OFF`).
     Then add two more columns on the **same tab** for the city filter —
     B1: `city`, C1: `enabled`, and one row per city with a real Google Sheets
     checkbox in column C (*Insert → Tick box*):
     `Bangalore ☑ | Delhi ☐ | Mumbai ☐ | Hyderabad ☐ | Remote ☐`
     Optional control row: `include_unknown_city ☐`
   - `Tracker` → header row:
     `company | recruiter_name | email | job_role | linkedin | source | source_tab | status | mail_count | last_mail_date | next_mail_date | reply_status | gmail_thread_id | notes | data_flags`
   - `Log` → header row:
     `timestamp | company | email | mail_number | result | thread_id | duration_ms`
4. Every other tab is treated as raw contact data automatically (5–6 tabs supported out of the box).
5. **New:** add an `Invalid Contacts` tab with headers:
   `moved_at | company | recruiter_name | email | job_role | source | source_tab | status | reason`
6. **New:** set `resume_file_path` (path **inside the n8n container**, e.g. mount `./files` → `/files`) plus `sender_name` / `sender_headline` / `sender_phone` / `sender_portfolio` in Workflow Config.
7. **New:** attach a **Google Calendar OAuth** credential to `Create Interview Calendar Event` and set `calendar_id` (`primary` by default).
8. Workflow timezone is set to Asia/Kolkata; the send-window check is timezone-safe either way.

## ⏱ Cadence & Statuses
Mail 1 → +2h → Mail 2 → +1h → Mail 3 → +1.5h → Mail 4 → +3h → Mail 5 → `Closed`.
Sends happen only 10:00–18:00 IST; follow-ups that fall due outside the window are sent on the next run inside the window.

**Terminal statuses (never mailed again):** Closed, Replied, Got Reply, Rejected, Mail Not Found, Skipped, Error.
- Set `Rejected` or `Skipped` manually in the Tracker to stop a row anytime.
- To retry an `Error` row, clear its status cell in the Tracker.

## ✍️ Email Content
`Generate Personalized Email` now writes a **real** subject + body for every send - no placeholders.
It personalizes on `recruiter_name` (professional fallback greeting when missing/generic), `company`, `job_role` and `source`, and varies the tone across mails 1-5.

Sender identity comes from **Workflow Config** (`sender_name`, `sender_headline`, `sender_phone`, `sender_portfolio`).

The resume is attached to **every** mail (first + follow-ups) via `Load Resume File` → `Attach Resume To Email`, binary property `resume`.

To swap in an LLM later, replace the subject/body construction and keep the output keys `subject` and `body`.

## 🛟 Resilience
- Reply check runs before **every** follow-up (Gmail search `from:<contact> after:<last mail>`). If the check itself fails, the send is skipped for that run rather than risking a mail to someone who already replied.
- Send errors are classified: invalid / unknown / unavailable recipient → `Mail Not Found` (never retried); anything else → `Error`.
- Sheets read/update/log nodes continue on error, so one bad row or tab cannot kill the whole run.
- **Invalid recipients are removed from the active flow:** a `Mail Not Found` classification appends the contact to the **`Invalid Contacts`** tab and leaves the Tracker status terminal, so it is never mailed again. (Rows are not hard-deleted - safer, and fully reversible.)

parameters.content:
## 📅 Interview Scheduling → Google Calendar
Runs **only** on the reply branch. `Fetch Reply Message` pulls the full reply text, `Detect Interview Intent` looks for scheduling keywords **and** parses a concrete date + time (IST, UTC+05:30).

An event is created **only when intent + date + time are all unambiguous**. Rejection/auto-reply wording is filtered out. If anything is vague, no event is created and the reply text is preserved on the row in `notes` / `interview_notes` for manual handling.

Needs a **Google Calendar OAuth2** credential (same Google account is fine).

## 📍 City Filter (checkbox, multi-select)
Ticked in the **Settings** tab, column `city` + checkbox column `enabled`. Tick one city or several — Bangalore today, Bangalore + Delhi later.

**Nothing is deleted.** Contacts in unticked cities are just not crawled or mailed this run; their rows and tracker state stay intact, so ticking that city later resumes them mid-sequence.

- **No city ticked → filter off**, everyone passes (safe default).
- Blank/unrecognized city → excluded, unless you tick the `include_unknown_city` control row.
- Matching is case/punctuation-insensitive and alias-aware: *Bengaluru, KA (Hybrid)* matches **Bangalore**. Edit `city_aliases` in **Workflow Config** to tune the alias map.
- Note: this also pauses **follow-ups** for unticked cities — by design.

## 🗑 Bounced-contact cleanup
When Gmail reports invalid / not-found / mailbox-unavailable, the contact is:
1. **Backed up** to the `Invalid Contacts` tab (full row + reason) - durable, reversible.
2. **Deleted** from its source HR tab by row number (`Delete Bounced Row From Source`).

Deletion uses the row number captured during this run. If two bounces hit the **same** tab in one run, row numbers shift after the first delete - rare, and the backup tab still has the data. The contact is already `Mail Not Found` (terminal) in the Tracker, so it is never mailed again regardless.
